title: Transport Delay
text: Delay input by given amount of time, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Time delay} sets Time delay; {Initial output}, {Initial buffer size} sets the initial memory allocation, {Use fixed buffer size} uses fixed-size buffer, {Direct feedthrough of input during linearization} enables direct feedthrough and {Pade order (for linearization)} sets the order of Pade approximation. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Initial output
params.values: Initial output value 0 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Initial buffer size
params.values: Initial memory allocation 1024 (default) | positive integer scalar

params.name: Direct feedthrough of input during linearization
Pade order (for linearization)
params.values: Order of Pade approximation 0 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix
